senses.gloss: f.(b. h. אֻמָּה; אמם to join , v. אֵם) people, nation, government.
units: Ab. Zar. 18ᵃ א׳ זו this (Roman) government; a. fr.—Pl. אוּמּוֹת nations; gentiles (contrad. to Israel); freq. א׳ העולם (abbr. או״הע, א״ה).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 39">Gen. R. s. 39</cite> <he>שבעים א׳</he> the seventy nations (in the Noachidic genealogy), v. <he>אֶוְותַּנְטִין</he>.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 3b:3">Ab. Zar. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>באין אוה״ע וכ׳</he> the gentiles shall come and be converted; a. fr.—<he>דיני א׳</he> (freq. <cite ref="P00731"><he>עכ״ום</he></cite>, <cite ref="C00358"><he>גוי</he></cite>) gentile (not Israelitish) law.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:1:9">Y. Kidd. I, 58ᵇ</cite> bot.; a. fr.—
